title: SB 1337 (2018 - Fifty-third Legislature - Second Regular Session (azleg session id 119)): voter identification; proof of citizenship
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id)
(section) Bill text
(quote) REFERENCE TITLE: voter identification; proof of citizenship
(section) Bill text
(quote) amending sections 16-152, 16-166 and 16-579, Arizona Revised Statutes; relating to voter identification.
(section) Sec. 2: Subject to the requirements of article IV, part 1, section 1, Constitution of Arizona, section 16-166, Arizona (para E)
(quote) E. The county recorder on or before May 1 of each year preceding a state primary and general election or more frequently as the recorder deems necessary may use the change of address information supplied by the postal service through its licensees to identify registrants whose addresses may have changed.
(section) Sec. 2: Subject to the requirements of article IV, part 1, section 1, Constitution of Arizona, section 16-166, Arizona (para 3)
(quote) 3. A legible photocopy of pertinent pages of the applicant's United States passport identifying the applicant and the applicant's passport number or presentation to the county recorder of the applicant's United States passport.
(section) Sec. 3: Subject to the requirements of article IV, part 1, section 1, Constitution of Arizona, section 16-579, Arizona
(quote) (a) A valid form of identification that bears the photograph, name and address of the elector that reasonably appear to be the same as the name and address in the precinct register, including an Arizona driver license, an Arizona nonoperating identification license, a tribal enrollment card or other form of tribal identification or a United States federal, state or local government issued identification.
(b_no_id_remedy)
(section) Sec. 1: Subject to the requirements of article IV, part 1, section 1, Constitution of Arizona, section 16-152, Arizona
(quote) (b) If the registrant does not have an Arizona driver license or nonoperating identification license, the last four digits of the registrant's social security number.
(section) Sec. 1: Subject to the requirements of article IV, part 1, section 1, Constitution of Arizona, section 16-152, Arizona
(quote) (c) If the registrant does not have an Arizona driver license or nonoperating identification license or a social security number and the registrant attests to that, a unique identifying number consisting of the registrant's unique identification number to be assigned by the secretary of state in the statewide electronic voter registration database.
(section) Sec. 1: Subject to the requirements of article IV, part 1, section 1, Constitution of Arizona, section 16-152, Arizona (para B)
(quote) The voter receipt is evidence of valid registration for the purpose of casting a provisional ballot as prescribed in section 16‑584, subsection B.
(section) Sec. 3: Subject to the requirements of article IV, part 1, section 1, Constitution of Arizona, section 16-579, Arizona
(quote) (c) A valid form of identification that bears the photograph, name and address of the elector except that if the address on the identification does not reasonably appear to be the same as the address in the precinct register or the identification is a valid United States military identification card or a valid United States passport and does not bear an address, the identification must be accompanied by one of the items listed in subdivision (b) of this paragraph.
(section) Sec. 3: Subject to the requirements of article IV, part 1, section 1, Constitution of Arizona, section 16-579, Arizona (para 2)
(quote) 2. If the elector does not present identification that complies with paragraph 1 of this subsection, the elector is only eligible to vote a provisional ballot as prescribed by section 16‑584 or a conditional provisional ballot as provided for in the secretary of state's instruction and procedures manual adopted pursuant to section 16‑452.
(c_mail_ballot_id)
(section) Sec. 3: Subject to the requirements of article IV, part 1, section 1, Constitution of Arizona, section 16-579, Arizona
(quote) (b) Two different items that contain the name and address of the elector that reasonably appear to be the same as the name and address in the precinct register, including a utility bill, a bank or credit union statement that is dated within ninety days of the date of the election, a valid Arizona vehicle registration, an Arizona vehicle insurance card, an Indian census card, tribal enrollment card or other form of tribal identification, a property tax statement, a recorder's certificate, a voter registration card, a valid United States federal, state or local government issued identification or any mailing that is labeled as "official election material".
(d_proof_of_citizenship)
(section) Bill text
(quote) REFERENCE TITLE: voter identification; proof of citizenship
(section) Sec. 2: Subject to the requirements of article IV, part 1, section 1, Constitution of Arizona, section 16-166, Arizona (para F)
(quote) F. The county recorder shall reject any application for registration that is not accompanied by satisfactory evidence of United States citizenship.
(section) Sec. 2: Subject to the requirements of article IV, part 1, section 1, Constitution of Arizona, section 16-166, Arizona (para F)
(quote) Satisfactory evidence of citizenship shall include any of the following:
(section) Sec. 2: Subject to the requirements of article IV, part 1, section 1, Constitution of Arizona, section 16-166, Arizona (para 1)
(quote) 1. The number of the applicant's driver license or nonoperating identification license issued after October 1, 1996 by the department of transportation or the equivalent governmental agency of another state within the United States if the agency indicates on the applicant's driver license or nonoperating identification license that the person has provided satisfactory proof of United States citizenship.
(section) Sec. 2: Subject to the requirements of article IV, part 1, section 1, Constitution of Arizona, section 16-166, Arizona (para 2)
(quote) 2. A legible photocopy of the applicant's birth certificate that verifies citizenship to the satisfaction of the county recorder.
(section) Sec. 2: Subject to the requirements of article IV, part 1, section 1, Constitution of Arizona, section 16-166, Arizona (para G)
(quote) G. Notwithstanding subsection F of this section, any person who is registered in this state on the effective date of this amendment to this section is deemed to have provided satisfactory evidence of citizenship and shall not be required to resubmit evidence of citizenship unless the person is changing voter registration from one county to another.
(section) Sec. 2: Subject to the requirements of article IV, part 1, section 1, Constitution of Arizona, section 16-166, Arizona (para H)
(quote) H. For the purposes of this section, proof of voter registration from another state or county is not satisfactory evidence of citizenship.
(section) Sec. 2: Subject to the requirements of article IV, part 1, section 1, Constitution of Arizona, section 16-166, Arizona (para I)
(quote) I. A person who modifies voter registration records with a new residence ballot shall not be required to submit evidence of citizenship.
(section) Sec. 2: Subject to the requirements of article IV, part 1, section 1, Constitution of Arizona, section 16-166, Arizona (para I)
(quote) After citizenship has been demonstrated to the county recorder, the person is not required to resubmit satisfactory evidence of citizenship in that county.
(section) Sec. 2: Subject to the requirements of article IV, part 1, section 1, Constitution of Arizona, section 16-166, Arizona (para J)
(quote) J. After a person has submitted satisfactory evidence of citizenship, the county recorder shall indicate this information in the person's permanent voter file.
(section) Sec. 2: Subject to the requirements of article IV, part 1, section 1, Constitution of Arizona, section 16-166, Arizona (para J)
(quote) After two years the county recorder may destroy all documents that were submitted as evidence of citizenship.
(e_other_rule)
(section) Sec. 1: Subject to the requirements of article IV, part 1, section 1, Constitution of Arizona, section 16-152, Arizona (para 3)
(quote) 3. The complete address of the registrant's actual place of residence, including street name and number, apartment or space number, city or town and zip code, or such description of the location of the residence that it can be readily ascertained or identified.
(section) Sec. 1: Subject to the requirements of article IV, part 1, section 1, Constitution of Arizona, section 16-152, Arizona (para 12)
(quote) One of the following identifiers for each registrant:
(section) Sec. 1: Subject to the requirements of article IV, part 1, section 1, Constitution of Arizona, section 16-152, Arizona
(quote) (a) The Arizona driver license number of the registrant or nonoperating identification license number of the registrant that is issued pursuant to section 28‑3165.
(section) Sec. 3: Subject to the requirements of article IV, part 1, section 1, Constitution of Arizona, section 16-579, Arizona
(quote) Identification is deemed valid unless it can be determined on its face that it has expired.
(other) Sec. 4: Requirements for enactment; three-fourths vote
